Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
There is one more copy of [the Trial](/book/53) that I should like to have sent to the Press - i.e., to [Events of the Month](/periodical/69), Mozley’s, 6 Paternoster Row - it is a sort of school room [Athenaeum](/periodical/170) which I wish to help forward
Thanks for your note. I hope nothing will prevent my meeting [Mrs D Macmillan](/person/941) and I shall be glad to talk over your scheme, and see if it comes within my views and capabilities. The [Golden Deeds](/book/51) have been most enjoyable work
Yours faithfully
C.M. Yonge
